gallery.title: Academic Scores & University Size
gallery.description: A Streamgraph summarizes eight academic award fields across academic level. Below it, a Scatterplot maps academic level against university size and uses nested Pie Charts for each university’s award profile.

file.name: academic_scores_wide.csv
file.description: One row per university, with academic level, university size, and eight separate academic award columns.

bindings.role: Streamgraph Y fold · Pie theta fold

gallery.composition: Nest the Pie Chart into each Scatterplot point, then concatenate the Streamgraph above the Scatterplot on their shared academic_level X axis.

editorHelp.introduction: The Streamgraph, Scatterplot, and Pie Chart are already on the canvas with data bound. Start with the small Pie Chart.

steps.title: Drag the Pie into the Scatterplot
steps.action: Press and hold the Pie Chart. Drag it through the circle labeled Enter in the middle of the Scatterplot. Keep holding, move onto a scatter point, and release when Nested appears.
steps.result: Pie Charts are repeated across the Scatterplot points, showing each university’s subject values.

steps.title: Place the Streamgraph above
steps.target: Drop strip just above the Scatterplot
steps.action: Drag the Streamgraph to the strip outside the Scatterplot’s top edge. Keep the pointer away from the central Enter circle. Release when the strip highlights with Concat · share X.
steps.result: The Streamgraph sits above the Scatterplot and shares its academic_level X axis.
